checks.evidence: Test 2 sends a new MA ending with an LOA and checks it is not flagged as shortening, but it never sets up an EOA-ended MA with gradient and speed profiles beyond it. The new LOA is not placed in rear of the old EOA, and nothing checks that the profiles beyond it are kept or that a later MA is accepted without new profiles.
